mapper.insert: insert into cv_storage ( user_id, cv_id, cv_name, shortlink, file_url, available, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{cvId}, #{cvName}, #{shortlink}, #{fileUrl}, #{available}, sysdate() )

INSERT INTO cv_access_code ( shortlink, access_code, accessible_count, deadline, available, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{short_link}, #{resumeAccessCode.accessCode}, #{resumeAccessCode.accessibleCount}, #{resumeAccessCode.deadline}, 1, 0 );
INSERT INTO cv_monitor (shortlink, date, count) VALUES (#{shortlink}, #{now}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE count = count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
INSERT INTO cv_access_log (shortlink, ip, browser, os, device) VALUES (#{shortlink},#{ip}, #{browser}, #{os}, #{device});
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, user_id AS userId, cv_id AS cvId, cv_name AS cvName, name AS name, phone AS phone, mail AS mail, shortlink AS shortlink, parse_content AS parseContent, process_status AS processStatus, file_url AS fileUrl, available AS available, deadline AS deadline, access_code_available AS accessCodeAvailable, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM cv_storage WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id AS id, user_id AS userId, cv_id AS cvId, cv_name AS cvName, name AS name, phone AS phone, mail AS mail, shortlink AS shortlink, parse_content AS parseContent, process_status AS processStatus, file_url AS fileUrl, available AS available, deadline AS deadline, access_code_available AS accessCodeAvailable, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM cv_storage WHERE user_id = #{userId}
select count(shortlink) from cv_storage where shortlink=#{shortlink};

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, cv_id AS cvId, cv_name AS cvName, name, phone, mail, shortlink, parse_content AS parseContent, process_status AS processStatus, file_url AS fileUrl, available, deadline, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy, remark, access_code_available AS accessCodeAvailable FROM cv_storage WHERE shortlink = #{shortlink}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_access_codes FROM cv_access_code ac JOIN cv_storage cs ON ac.shortlink = cs.shortlink WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} and ac.del_flag = 0;

SELECT ac.id, ac.shortlink, ac.access_code AS accessCode, ac.accessible_count AS accessibleCount, ac.deadline, ac.available, ac.create_time AS createTime, ac.update_time AS updateTime FROM cv_access_code ac JOIN cv_storage cs ON ac.shortlink = cs.shortlink WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} AND ac.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY ac.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update:
update cv_storage
cv_id = #{cvId},
cv_name = #{cvName},
shortlink = #{shortlink},
file_url = #{fileUrl},
available = #{available},
access_code_available = #{accessCodeAvailable},
name = #{name},
phone = #{phone},
mail = #{mail},
parse_content = #{parseContent},
update_time = sysdate()
where user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE cv_storage SET name = #{parseContent.name}, phone = #{parseContent.phone}, mail = #{parseContent.mail}, parse_content = #{parseContent.parseContent}, process_status = #{statusCode}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId};
